parameters.content:
## 1. Trigger & Config Ingestion
Every 5 minutes, read dynamic system settings (max retries, rate limits, alerts) from Google Sheets Settings tab.

## 2. Multi-Zone Engine & Anti-Collision
Converts schedule_date + schedule_time in the post timezone to UTC using Luxon. Enforces 24h missed window, locks row in "Processing" state to prevent race conditions.

## 3. Platform Execution Matrix
Switches by platform across 8 social networks: Meta (Facebook, Instagram, Threads), LinkedIn, X, YouTube, Pinterest, and TikTok. Each HTTP node uses Continue On Fail.

## 4. Normalization, Audit Logging & Alerts
Extracts post URLs, classifies failures (AUTH_ERROR, RATE_LIMIT, etc.), marks expired credentials, updates Google Sheets, and dispatches Slack + Email summaries.
